description:
In this highly visible role, you will be at the center of a chip design effort interfacing with many disciplines, with a critical impact on getting high quality products to millions of customers quickly.

Description
As a CPU verification ML tool engineer owning the ML based verification tools, and flow of a high performance lower power processor design, you will have the responsibilities as follows:

Work closely with verification engineers and RTL designers on defining effective ML based verification for low power complex processor design.
Drive and develop the ML based tools and flows for CPU verification.
Developing, verifying, and maintaining efficient testbench environments
Test the ML based tools and flows with selected blocks from the real design

Minimum qualifications
Minimum BS
Experience with Programming/scripting in one or more of the following languages: C, C++, Python
Computer Architecture coursework or experience

Preferred qualifications
RTL development experience 
Programming skills with Verilog or SystemVerilog
Machine Learning experience 
Strong broblem solving skills
Excellent communication skills and able to work independently.
all_locations: Santa Clara, United States of America
